items.title: HPE shares jump 5% as Morgan Stanley upgrade points to nearly 30% upside
items.summary: HP Enterprise (NYSE:HPE) shares climbed 5% in Monday’s pre-market trading after Morgan Stanley upgraded the enterprise technology company from “Equalweight” to “Overweight,” citing an increasingly attractive outlook for earnings, cash generation and valuation. The investment bank set a $69 price target on HPE.

items.title: Analyst turns more bullish on hardware stocks as ‘chipflation’ accelerates demand
items.summary: Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley has turned more constructive on IT hardware, upgrading its industry view as it argued that memory "chipflation" is accelerating infrastructure demand rather than delaying it.
